meta.title: Trajectory review
meta.description: Adds a Trajectory review view to a session. When you turn it on, a background reviewer grades each step on task completion quality, safety and privacy, reporting and evaluation integrity, and execution efficiency. Node shapes separate thinking, messages, tool runs, and edits; colours separate pass, needs attention, and fail. Review uses the session's own model and sends extra model requests; results stay in the plugin's own record and never enter the main model context.
